options: B will not go on the trip tomorrow.
A did not know B was sick before they talked.
A and B had planned to go to Jeju-do together.
B's reason for not going is a health problem.
A wants B to get well soon.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I hear you're going on a trip to Jeju-do tomorrow. Have a great time!
B: Thanks, but I don't think I can. I don't feel well.
A: Oh, no. What's wrong?
B: I have a terrible cold.
A: I'm so sorry. I just hope you feel better soon.

다음 대화의 내용으로 보아 추론할 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 A가 B에게 "Have a great time!"이라고 말한 것으로 보아 두 사람이 함께 여행을 갈 계획이 있었다는 것을 직접적으로 알 수 없습니다. A가 단순히 B의 여행을 축하한 것일 수 있습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Today is the first day of school. How's it going, Chris?
B: Good, but I'm a little relaxed.
A: You'll be all right. I hope you make lots of friends soon.
B: I hope so, too. Thank you, Ms. Lee.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 학교 첫날에 '편안함(relaxed)'을 느낀다는 것은 문맥상 어울리지 않습니다. 학교 첫날에는 보통 '긴장하거나(nervous)' '불안해(anxious)' 하므로, 'relaxed' 대신 'nervous'나 'anxious'가 적절합니다.

options: He doubts if dolphins from the aquarium can live in the wild.
He feels bored because his job was just doing simple errands.
He is proud and happy to help with the project, even with a small role.
He is worried that his small mistakes might ruin the whole project.
He thinks the training methods of the aquarium staff are wrong.
questions.question:
[지문]
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

다음 글에서 드러나는 필자(Inho)의 태도로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 필자는 '정말로 프로젝트의 일부가 되고 싶었고(I really wanted to be part of the project)' '운이 좋게 기회를 얻었으며(Luckily, I got the chance)' '단순한 심부름만 했지만 그 경험으로 매우 흥분했다(but the experience made me so excited)'고 했으므로, 작은 역할이라도 프로젝트를 돕는 것에 자랑스러워하고 행복해하는 태도를 보여줍니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Many dolphins get sick or even die (A) [because / because of] plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. (B) [Clean / Cleaning] up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member (C) [in / of] Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) '~때문에'는 'because of + 명사'이므로 'because of'가 맞습니다. (B) 주어 자리에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 'Cleaning'이 맞습니다. (C) 'a member of ~'는 '~의 멤버'를 의미하므로 'of'가 맞습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
JAN 5
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something. So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

(A) This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild.

(B) Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time.

(C) Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there.
questions.explanation: 시간 순서로 보면: (C) 오늘 해변 정소(Today), (A) 오늘 오후 훈련 참여(This afternoon), (B) 나중에 돌고래가 바다로 돌아가는 날(Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea)이 되어야 합니다. 따라서 (C)-(A)-(B) 순서가 맞습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: I hear (a) you're going on a trip to Jeju-do tomorrow. Have a great time!
B: Thanks, but I don't think (b) I can. (c) I don't feel well.
A: Oh, no. What's wrong?
B: (d) I have a terrible cold.
A: (e) I'm so sorry. I just hope you feel better soon.

다음 밑줄 친 (a)~(e) 중에서 가리키는 대상이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: (a) you = B를 가리킴, (b) I = B를 가리킴, (c) I = B를 가리킴, (d) I = B를 가리킴, (e) I = A를 가리킵니다. (e)만 A를 가리키므로 나머지와 다릅니다.

options: B has decided to cancel the trip.
B is asking A for help with a cold.
B is worried about the weather in Jeju-do.
B is not sure he will enjoy the trip because he is sick.
B thinks A should not have wished them a great time.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I hear you're going on a trip to Jeju-do tomorrow. Have a great time!
B: Thanks, but (A) I don't think I can. I don't feel well.
A: Oh, no. What's wrong?
B: I have a terrible cold.
A: I'm so sorry. I just hope you feel better soon.
(A: girl, B: boy)

다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)가 맥락상 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'I don't think I can'은 '가지 못할 것 같다'는 의미로, B가 감기 때문에 여행을 즐길 수 없을 것이라고 확신하지 못한다는 뜻입니다. 확정적으로 취소를 선언한 것이 아니라 불확실함을 표현합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

다음 글을 읽고 'Dolphin Lovers'의 운영 방식과 Inho의 참여에 관해 추론할 수 있는 내용을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?

<보기>
ㄱ. The club carries out various activities to protect the sea environment and animals.
ㄴ. In the training class, Inho played a supporting role instead of teaching the dolphins himself.
ㄷ. Inho was chosen for the project mainly because he had professional training skills.
ㄹ. The text implies that Inho and his aunt planned to meet at the beach cleanup party in advance.
questions.explanation: ㄱ. 글에서 다양한 활동(해변 정소, 돌고래 훈련 프로젝트)을 언급하므로 참입니다. ㄴ. 'I just ran some errands'로 보조적 역할을 했으므로 참입니다. ㄷ. 글에서 전문 훈련을 받아서 선택되었다는 언급이 없습니다. ㄹ. 'What a small world!'는 우연한 만남을 나타내므로 사전에 계획하지 않은 것으로 볼 수 있어 거짓입니다. 따라서 ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ이 아니라 ㄱ, ㄴ입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. ___(A)___, we do various activities. ___(B)___, we hold zero-waste challenges and tree planting events. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 목표를 이루기 위해 다양한 활동을 한다는 의미이므로 'For this'(이를 위해)가 적절합니다. (B)는 구체적인 활동의 예를 들므로 'For example'(예를 들어)이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something. So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. (A) 그것은 해변을 청소하고 돌고래를 돕는 것과 같은 다양한 활동을 한다. After some thought, I joined it today.

<조건>
- 주어진 단어를 배열하여 영작할 것
- It / activities / does / various / cleaning / such / as / up / beaches / and / helping / dolphins

다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 6번째에 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 정렬된 문장: It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. 각 단어의 위치: 1.It 2.does 3.various 4.activities 5.such 6.as 7.cleaning 8.up... 따라서 6번째는 'as'입니다. 답은 ②번입니다.

questions.question:
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so ________.

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 주어 I(사람)가 경험에 의해 흥분한 상태이므로, 감정을 나타내는 과거분사 'excited'가 적절하다. 'Exciting'은 '흥미로운(사물이)'이므로 맞지 않다.

options: To give a serious report about the dolphin crisis in Jeju-do.
To encourage other teenagers to join NGO activities by sharing a personal experience.
To show that personal efforts are not enough to solve big environmental problems.
To keep a record of new members for the club 'Dolphin Lovers'.
To explain that searching the Internet is the best way to find an NGO.
questions.question:
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way to learn about social issues and make the world better. Are you interested? Then, read Inho's blog below. 다음 글의 구성 방식으로 보아, 이 글을 쓴 의도로 추론할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 글은 청소년들에게 NGO 활동을 권유하는 도입부로 시작하고, Inho의 개인적인 경험(NGO를 찾아 참여한 과정)을 블로그 형식으로 공유하고 있다. 따라서 개인 경험을 통해 다른 청소년들을 NGO 활동에 참여하도록 격려하는 것이 의도이다.

questions.question:
A: Hello, teens! Do you want (A) [to make / make] the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we (B) [hold / holding] zero-waste challenges and tree planting events. (C) [Interested / Interesting]? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'want to do'의 형태로 to부정사 필요 → 'to make' (B) 'we hold'로 현재형 필요 → 'hold' (C) 뒤에 물음표가 있고 청자에게 '관심 있냐'고 묻는 맥락이므로 청자의 특성을 묘사하는 'Interested' (관심 있는)

questions.question:
A: This weekend, I'm (A) [run / running] a marathon for the first time.
B: Really? I hope you finish the race.
A: I hope so, too, but I'm a little (B) [worried / worry].
B: Just do your best. You'll (C) [do / to do] great.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'I'm ~ing' 진행형이므로 'running' (B) 'I'm a little ~'은 형용사 필요 → 'worried' (C) 'You'll do'로 조동사 뒤에 동사원형 → 'do'

questions.question:

다음 밑줄 친 ~ 중 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 옳게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: 'I enjoying it'은 문법적으로 틀렸다. 'I was enjoying it' 또는 'I enjoyed it'이어야 한다. 여기서는 과거 시점에서 그 활동을 했으므로 'enjoyed'가 적절하다.

(A) = The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is __________ them back to the sea.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)와 의미가 같도록 문장을 전환할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'to return them to the sea' = 'to sending them back to the sea' 구조이다. 'is ~ing'로 표현될 수 있으며, 보기에서 'to sending'이 정답이다.

options: He regretted that he could not help the dolphins more in the project.
He was very worried that the dolphins would not survive in the wild sea.

questions.explanation: 필자는 감정적이었고(emotional) 약간 울었지만(cried a little), 동시에 행복했다(happy). 이는 돌핑이를 더 이상 볼 수 없게 되어 슬프지만(goodbye), 그들이 자유롭게 살게 되어 행복한 복잡한 감정을 나타낸다.

questions.explanation: "something을 해야 한다고 생각했다" → "인터넷을 검색했다"로 연결되므로 인과관계를 나타내는 'Therefore(따라서)'가 적절하다.
